model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the quantity of land in hectares for several countries over the years 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled “Години” and ranging from 2013 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Хилјади хектари”, represents the quantity in thousands of hectares, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1200, and tick marks at intervals of 200.  The chart consists of grouped bars for each year, with each group representing the land quantity for Spain (blue), France (orange), China/continental (light blue), Italy (yellow), Turkey (green), USA (teal), and Argentina (dark blue). Within each year, the bars are arranged in the order listed in the legend. In 2013, the approximate values are: Spain at 720, France at 600, China at 800, Italy at 400, Turkey at 280, USA at 320, and Argentina at 480. In 2022, the approximate values are: Spain at 780, France at 560, China at 720, Italy at 360, Turkey at 240, USA at 300, and Argentina at 200. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
